summary: Once the board adopts {report}, the chair disbands the group that wrote it.
realLife: After the committee approved its report on improving coin and medal design, Gary Marks declared the design excellence subcommittee's assignment finished and dissolved it.
gates: A temporary committee has delivered the report it was appointed to prepare.
inGame: needs: subcommittee charge and adoption of its final report.

turns.what: The board extends the group's assignment.
turns.pulledBy: Members ask for a follow-up on implementation.
turns.writesBack: The group receives a new reporting date.

turns.what: A recommendation needs an owner after dissolution.
turns.pulledBy: The adopted report names no one to carry it out.
turns.writesBack: The full board assigns the follow-up to a member.
